parts:
Thank you for your reply. I tried to convert the bed.gz files using the following code

for files in *.gz 
do 
         gzip -dc "$files" | tail +2 | gzip -c > "$files".tmp 
          if [ "$?" -eq 0 ]; then 
                  mv "$files".tmp "$files" 
          fi 
done

However I got the following results 

tail: cannot open ‘+2’ for reading: No such file or directory

gzip: stdout: Broken pipe
tail: cannot open ‘+2’ for reading: No such file or directory

gzip: stdout: Broken pipe

I'm really confused why methylKit won't work on gemBS bed.gz files with the following columns 
  1. Contig 
  2. Pos0 
  3. Pos1 
  4. Ref 
  5. Call 
  6. Flags 
  7. Meth 
  8. non_conv 
  9. conv 
  10. support_call 
  11. total
Is there an easy way to convert these columns to just the ones that methylKit can read. Which columns would I remove and which ones would I merge. 

Apologies for my novice background. Our lab is a wet lab with no bioinformatics support. 

Thanks
